description: A private note that HR may need to replace the person in a seat (slice 065). Read only through Positions. Erased, never kept: no change history, no comments, no copy on delete.

fields.description: The seat assignment this plan is about. Plain text on purpose, not a link: Frappe's "linked documents" count would otherwise tell people a plan exists.
fields.label: Seat assignment

fields.description: Why a replacement is planned. Set once; to change it, remove the plan and set it again. The blank first option means nobody gets a reason by default.
fields.label: Reason
fields.options:
Performance
Personal reasons
Other business reason

fields.description: Performance only: 30 to 60 days from the day the plan is set. Hiring is on hold until this date and until HR records the outcome.
fields.label: Improvement period ends on

fields.description: Set only by recording the outcome "Not improved".
fields.label: Not improved, recorded on

fields.description: Plain text on purpose, not a link to User, for the same reason as the seat assignment. Set only by recording the outcome.
fields.label: Not improved, recorded by

name: Replacement Plan
